name: Dallenor
description: Dallenor was a desert planet located in the Aldino sector of the Mid Rim. An excavation led by the archaeologist Clatriffe discovered a Jedi holocron on the planet, notifying the Jedi Order. To inspect the holocron, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker traveled to Dallenor on behalf of the Jedi Council.
